channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Over 150 artists, cultural workers call on government to withdraw Eurovision participation
item.description: More than 150 artists and cultural workers have called on the government to withdraw Malta from the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest if Israel is allowed to participate

item.title: Former Prince Andrew arrested over misconduct claims
item.description: Recently released Epstein files alleged that a woman was trafficked to the UK to have sexual encounters with former Prince Andrew

item.title: State ordered to pay €254,000 over derisory rent of Labours Valletta club as tenants escape eviction
item.description: Constitutional Court rules owners of a prime Republic Street property, used as a Labour Party club for 70 years, suffered a breach of their fundamental rights • Court does not force eviction

item.title: Fraudster used text messages, fake bank apps to swindle hundreds of victims
item.description: Court hears how Tammy Caruana’s alleged fraud operations were identified after police received an anonymous letter outlining her operations

item.title: Appeal lodged against two 14-storey hotels in Tas-Sliema upheld
item.description: Planning Tribunal upholds appeal filed by residents, environmental organisations and the Sliema Local Council, revoking a permit that allowed the construction of two 14-storey hotels with 158 rooms in a residential street in Sliema

item.title: IDC Malta launches Boardroom Excellence Workshop Series 2026
item.description: The full-day workshops will be hosted at leading national institutions and IFSP / IDC strategic partners

item.title: Governments current labour migration approach a panicked, directionless reaction, PN says
item.description: The Nationalist Party claims government's current labour migration approach are patch-up proposal not grounded in proper data

item.title: Residential building permits surge by over half at the end of 2025
item.description: Data from the Nationalist Statistics Office shows a sharp increase in approved dwellings across Malta and Gozo, with apartments making up nearly three-quarters of all new units

item.title: WATCH | Robert Abela says government has put forward new name for chief justice
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela tells MaltaToday government has presented a name for the post of chief justice for the Opposition’s consideration • PM slams Alex Borg for ‘linking’ chief justice appointment to general election

item.title: Developer declares public ownership on land earmarked for Buġibba lido
item.description: Revised plans for a Buġibba foreshore lido reveal the site is partly or wholly government-owned, correcting a previous application that stated otherwise
